title: Verify Time Clock user cannot reach work order notes, returns, or inspections
preconds: Log in to ShopView as a user assigned the Time Clock role. (Time Clock has Work Orders = View with View Mode empty and everything else Off, so the v33 work-order features are not reachable in practice).
steps:
1. Check whether any work order detail content (Notes tab, part returns, digital inspections) can be opened.
2. Check the navigation for Parts > Returns.
expected: None of the v33 work-order features (notes, part returns, inspections) are reachable: the screens are hidden or empty for the Time Clock user.
